stem: $\overline{AB}$ is a diameter of circle M and $m(\widehat{AD}) = 100^\circ$. Arc ACD goes from A through C and B to D (the long way round). Complete: $m(\widehat{ACD}) = \ldots$. Drag the points to set the measure of arc ACD.
solution: Arc ACD goes from A through C and B to D, so it is the whole circle minus arc AD.

hints.text: Arc ACD is the long way round. Check which of the two arcs between A and D you set.
The arc measure is its central angle itself. Check which angle you have set.
Subtract the small arc from the measure of the whole circle.
